```{r plot-original-data-metaecos, fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.width = figures_width_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT ORIGINAL DATA MEAN ± 95 % CI --- #

ggarrange(plot.metaecos.legend(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                              response_variable_selected),
          plot.metaecos.points(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                               response_variable_selected)  +
            rremove("xlab") +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "none") +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) + 
            ggtitle(fixed_label),
          plot.metaecos.points(ds_metaecosystems %>% 
                                 filter(disturbance_percentage == "decreasing_with_size"),
                               response_variable_selected)  +
            font("xlab", size = size_y_axis) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(ds_metaecosystems$day)) +
            theme(legend.position = "none") +
            ggtitle(relative_label),
          heights = c(0.25, 0.6, 0.6),
          nrow = 3,
          align = "v")
```

<details>
<summary>A plot per ecosystem size - means </summary>
```{r plot-original-data-one-size-per-plot-metaecos, fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.width = figures_width_rmd_output, message=FALSE}

# --- PLOT ORIGINAL DATA MEAN ± 95 % CI WITH ONE PLOT PER ECOSYSTEM SIZE --- #

# Set parameters

sizes = unique(ds_metaecosystems$ecosystem_size_ml)
p = list()

# Plot original data one plot per ecosystem size for fixed disturbance %
# across ecosystem sizes.

for(ecosystem_size_ml_i in 1:length(sizes)){
  
  # Prepare data
  
  data_for_plotting = ds_metaecosystems %>% 
    filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed",
           ecosystem_size_ml == sizes[ecosystem_size_ml_i])

  # Plot
  
  p[[ecosystem_size_ml_i]] = plot.metaecos.points(data_for_plotting,
                                                  response_variable_selected) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
    
}

# Show plots bound together 

print("Disturbance percentage FIXED")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p[[1]], 
                        p[[2]], 
                        p[[3]], 
                        p[[4]], 
                        nrow = 2, 
                        ncol = 2)

# Plot original data one plot per ecosystem size for decreasing disturbance %
# across ecosystem sizes.

for(ecosystem_size_ml_i in 1:length(sizes)){
  
  # Prepare data
  
  data_for_plotting = ds_metaecosystems %>% 
      filter(disturbance_percentage == "decreasing_with_size",
             ecosystem_size_ml == sizes[ecosystem_size_ml_i])
  
  # Plot
  
  p[[ecosystem_size_ml_i]] = plot.metaecos.points(data_for_plotting,
                                                  response_variable_selected) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# Show plots bound together 

print("Disturbance percentage DECREASING WITH SIZE")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p[[1]], 
                        p[[2]], 
                        p[[3]], 
                        p[[4]], 
                        nrow = 2, 
                        ncol = 2)
```
